description_en: Resets the workflow node configuration to the default values
description_zh: 重置工作流节点配置为默认值
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo reset-workflow-node-configuration --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --instance-id inst_2081 --node-id node_7f3a2c --expected-version 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetWorkflowNodeConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID；缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration version returned by the read API. This must be a non-negative integer. Refresh the data if a version conflict occurs
parameters.help_zh: 读取接口返回的configVersion；非负整数；版本冲突须刷新
parameters.name: expected_version
